name: tracekit
mission: HAR recording in. OpenAPI spec, SDK and MCP server out.
missionLines: OpenAPI spec, SDK and MCP server out.
flowAlt: Data flow: a HAR file is parsed and only JSON and fetch calls are kept. Secrets are redacted first, then the busiest origin is chosen. In analysis, raw paths are clustered into templates, request and response samples are merged into JSON Schema, and auth plus call order are detected. The output is openapi.yaml with tracekit.json, a typed TypeScript SDK, and an MCP server with one tool per operation.

nodes: fetch, XHR and JSON calls kept
